topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Code of conduct; POL-05 acknowledged at hire and each year; sanctions in POL-01 4.8, with misuse of regulated data reported to the agency
gap: The 2026 policy set must be acknowledged by all 600 staff before the period

control_description: Board audit committee receives quarterly cyber risk reports from the vCISO; PE sponsor representation on the board
Information Security Officer designated (Director of Information Security); system owner (CTO); risk acceptance authorities in POL-01 4.4
Screening by position (STD-10); role training for engineers and responders; CJIS and FTI training for designated staff
gap: 18 staff held CJI or FTI access before screening; 7 FTI staff overdue for recertification (P07 PS-3, AT-2)
remediation: Screening gate and access suspension at expiry (POAM-005, POAM-013)

control_description: Control owners named in the SSP; POA&M owners report monthly; sanctions applied
Component inventory from infrastructure code; data inventory; SIEM with MDR
gap: Data inventory missed the analytics copy of AG-01 notes; cryptographic module inventory incomplete
remediation: Quarterly data inventory confirmation; module inventory (POAM-004, POAM-007)

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies on the intranet; awareness training; 1-hour reporting rule
gap: 4 of 15 managed services staff interviewed did not know the 1-hour reporting rule (P07 IR-6)

control_description: Agency security contacts in every contract; notification matrix; status page; interconnection agreements
gap: No interconnection agreement for AG-39; out-of-state notice clocks not mapped (P07 CA-3)

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Service commitments from agency contracts (RTO, RPO, availability, security terms) recorded in the SSP and BIA
Annual risk assessment with SP 800-30 tables (P01); 52 risks with owners
Insider misuse, business email compromise, and staff fraud risks in P01 (R-005, R-048, R-049)
Security review of architecture changes; risk review for new states and acquisitions (POL-01 4.15)
gap: Acquisition due diligence checklist not yet written (R-043)

control_description: Independent annual assessment by the co-sourced internal audit firm (P07); monthly metrics; continuous posture checks
POA&M with owners and dates, reported to the audit committee each quarter

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from the SP 800-53 Moderate baseline with overlays (P02)
Infrastructure as code; guardrails; hardened images; signed deployments

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: POL-01 to POL-05 approved 2026-09-17; 10 standards (STD-01 to STD-10)
gap: Four new standards are drafts (STD-03, STD-04, STD-05, STD-10)
remediation: Issue standards on the P06 schedule

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: Single sign-on with MFA; FTI enclave isolation; customer-managed keys; privileged access gateway
gap: Push MFA for staff with regulated or agency system access; SYS-10 secrets exposure (P07 IA-5)

control_description: HR-driven provisioning; manager approval; agency administrators approve agency users
Just-in-time cloud administration; tenant roles; removal at termination
gap: Support staff read all regulated tenants; access kept after project close and transfer; annual reviews (P07 AC-2, AC-6, PS-5)
remediation: Quarterly reviews; removal triggers; ticket-scoped roles (POAM-001, POAM-002)

control_description: Data centers inherited from the cloud provider (carve-out); office badge access with quarterly review
Contract-end deletion with certificates; laptop wipe; certified disposal vendor
gap: Archive and backup copies for 3 former customers not deleted (P07 MP-6)

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: WAF, DDoS protection, cloud firewall with inbound deny by default, FTI enclave with no internet route
gap: Production egress open to any HTTPS destination; SYS-10 path into the landing zone (P07 SC-7, AC-17)
remediation: Egress allow-list; remove the path (POAM-021, POAM-003)

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS 1.2 or higher; FIPS 140-3 at the web ingress; FTI enclave; regulated attachments blocked in ticketing
gap: CJI message-switch connectors not FIPS 140-3; FTI notes copied to analytics until 2026-09-08 (P07 SC-8, SC-13; P03 PB-09)
remediation: Certified modules by 2026-09-21; purge and tag (POAM-007, POAM-004)

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on laptops and jump servers; container runtime protection; signed images verified at deployment
evidence: EDR console; signing logs (P07 SI-7 fully satisfied)

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Daily posture checks; weekly authenticated scans; CJIS remediation timelines
gap: 2 high penetration test findings past 30 days (P07 RA-5)

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: 24x7 MDR on cloud, identity, endpoints, firewalls
gap: No monitoring of regulated-record access or SYS-10; no logging-failure alerts (P07 AU-2, AU-5, AU-6, SI-4)
remediation: Application and SYS-10 logs to the SIEM; weekly analytics (POAM-006, POAM-018)

control_description: MDR triage with escalation within 30 minutes; security case system with categories
POL-03; P08 runbooks for ransomware and insider misuse; notification matrix; insurer panel
gap: Runbooks new; no agency tabletop yet; managed services incidents handled outside the process (P07 IR-4, IR-8)

control_description: Write-once vault; point-in-time recovery; rebuild from infrastructure code
gap: No tested rebuild in a clean account (P07 CP-10)

control_description: Pull requests with two approvals and automated tests; weekly change advisory review; emergency change procedure
evidence: Change records (P07 CM-3: 9 of 10 statements satisfied)
gap: Emergency changes in the FTI enclave without second approver or review (P07 CM-3)

control_description: BIA (P05); contingency plan; cyber insurance
gap: Contingency plan predates the landing zone and has no SYS-10 or region B procedures

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Vendor register; Tier 1 SOC 2 reviews (`vendor-soc2-review.csv`); contract terms
gap: 13 of 22 vendors not reviewed in 12 months; SYS-10 vendor not reviewed since 2023 (P07 SA-9, SR-6)

control_description: Managed services scale automatically; capacity alerts; quarterly capacity review; DDoS protection
Provider data centers (carve-out); 3 zones; region B replicas; write-once vault in region B (P07 CP-9 fully satisfied)
gap: Document storage not in the vault; region B application build needs manual steps
remediation: Vault copy of document storage; scripted region B build (POAM-009)

control_description: Quarterly single-tenant restore tests
gap: Full-tenant restore took 14 hours against the 8-hour RTO; plan never tested as a whole (P07 CP-4)
remediation: Timed restores twice a year; region B failover (POAM-009)

topic_label: Identification and maintenance of confidential information
control_description: Five-level classification (POL-04); FTI enclave; tagged FTI fields; masking pipeline for non-production
gap: Free-text FTI not tagged; analytics copy found (P03 PB-09, PB-15)
remediation: Tag note fields; quarterly inventory confirmation (POAM-004)

control_description: Contract-end deletion procedure with certificate; Exhibit 7 purge certification for FTI
gap: Same as CC6.5
